prompt: 哪一句讓步倒裝是正確的？
options: Young as she is, she leads the team well.
Young although she is, she leads the team well.
As young she is, she leads the team well.
answer: Young as she is, she leads the team well.

wrong.Young although she is, she leads the tea: 形容詞 + as + 主詞 + be 的倒裝結構中，as 已經表示「雖然」，不能再加 although。
wrong.As young she is, she leads the team well: 倒裝讓步句是把形容詞放在 as 之前，As young she is 的語序不成立。

why: 形容詞／名詞／副詞 + as + 主詞 + 動詞，意思是「雖然…」，Young as she is = Although she is young。
tip: 形容詞 + as + 主詞 + be，表示「雖然」。
say: Young as she is, she leads the team well.

text: _____ hard he tried, he could not lift the heavy box.
options: However
Whatever
Although

wrong.Whatever: Whatever 後面接名詞，不能直接修飾 hard 這個副詞。
wrong.Although: Although 後面要接完整句，不能把 hard 直接放在 although 後面再接 he tried。

why: However + 形容詞／副詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，表示「不管多麼…」，這裡修飾 hard。
tip: However + 形容詞／副詞，表示「無論多麼」。
say: However hard he tried, he could not lift the heavy box.

prompt: 哪一句使用 while 表示對比最正確？
options: While some students prefer music, others like silence.
While some students prefer music, but others like silence.
While some students prefer music, so others like silence.
answer: While some students prefer music, others like silence.

wrong.While some students prefer music, but ot: While 已經表示對比，後面再加 but 會變成重複連接，英文不能同時使用。
wrong.While some students prefer music, so oth: so 表示「所以」，但兩者之間是對比而非因果。

why: While 可以表示「然而；另一方面」，連接兩個對比的子句，一個連接詞就夠了。
tip: 一個句子只用一個連接詞，while 不加 but。
say: While some students prefer music, others like silence.

prompt: 這句話最接近哪個意思？
text: Much as I admire her, I can't agree with her plan.
options: 雖然我很欣賞她，但無法同意她的計畫。
因為我很欣賞她，所以同意她的計畫。
我不欣賞她，也不同意她的計畫。
answer: 雖然我很欣賞她，但無法同意她的計畫。

wrong.因為我很欣賞她，所以同意她的計畫。: Much as 是讓步「雖然」，後面是 can't agree，所以並不是因果關係。
wrong.我不欣賞她，也不同意她的計畫。: 句子明確說 admire her，是欣賞她，只是不同意計畫。

why: Much as I admire her 等於 Although I admire her very much，後面轉折為 can't agree。
tip: Much as 開頭是「雖然非常…」。
say: Much as I admire her, I can't agree with her plan.

prompt: 你想說：「就算他很有錢，他也不快樂。」哪一句最正確？
options: Rich as he is, he is not happy.
Rich as is he, he is not happy.
As rich he is, he is not happy.
answer: Rich as he is, he is not happy.

讓步倒裝是形容詞提前，但 as 後面的主詞與 be 仍保持 he is 的順序。
形容詞 rich 必須放在 as 前面，不能放在 as 後面。

why: Rich as he is 表示讓步「儘管他富有」，後面接結果相反的主要子句。
tip: Rich as he is 等於 Although he is rich。
say: Rich as he is, he is not happy.

text: Try _____ she might, she couldn't open the jar.
options: as
so
if

wrong.so: so 表示「所以」，不能構成「儘管怎麼努力」的讓步倒裝。
wrong.if: if 是「如果」，語意變成假設，不是已發生事實的讓步。

why: 動詞原形 + as + 主詞 + might，是讓步倒裝，意思是「儘管她怎麼試」。
tip: 動詞原形 + as + 主詞，也可以表示讓步。
say: Try as she might, she couldn't open the jar.

prompt: 哪一句 whereas 的用法正確？
options: My brother loves math, whereas I prefer history.
My brother loves math, whereas but I prefer history.
Whereas my brother loves math, therefore I prefer history.
answer: My brother loves math, whereas I prefer history.

wrong.My brother loves math, whereas but I pre: whereas 已有對比的意思，不能再與 but 並用。
wrong.Whereas my brother loves math, therefore: therefore 表示結果，但兩人興趣不同是對比，不是因果。

why: whereas 用來連接兩個形成對比的事實，語氣比 but 正式。
tip: whereas 表示對比，不要再加 but。
say: My brother loves math, whereas I prefer history.

prompt: 下列哪個句子的意思與 Though he was tired, he kept running. 相同？
options: Tired as he was, he kept running.
So tired was he that he kept running.
He was tired because he kept running.
answer: Tired as he was, he kept running.

So...that 表示因為太累所以怎樣，是結果，不是讓步轉折。
because 說的是他累是因為一直跑，因果顛倒，原句說的是累了還繼續跑。

why: Though he was tired 可以改寫成 Tired as he was，兩者都表示「儘管」。
tip: Though 子句可改成「形容詞 + as + 主詞 + be」。
say: Tired as he was, he kept running.

text: _____ the weather was cold, we decided to go hiking.
options: Even though
Because
Unless

wrong.Because: 天氣冷通常不是想去爬山的原因，用 because 邏輯不通。
wrong.Unless: unless 是「除非」，不能用來表示已知事實的讓步。

why: Even though 引導已發生的事實，表示「雖然天氣很冷，還是決定去爬山」。
tip: Even though 接事實，Even if 接假設。
say: Even though the weather was cold, we decided to go hiking.

prompt: 朋友邀你參加，你想說：「不管多忙，我都會去。」哪一句最合適？
options: However busy I am, I will come.
Whatever busy I am, I will come.
Although busy however I am, I will come.
answer: However busy I am, I will come.

Whatever 後面通常接名詞，不能直接接形容詞 busy。
Although 與 however 重複，而且語序混亂。

why: However + 形容詞 + 主詞 + be，表示「無論多麼…」，語氣自然。
tip: however 後面接形容詞或副詞。
say: However busy I am, I will come.

prompt: 哪一句 no matter 的用法正確？
options: No matter how late it is, I will wait for you.
No matter how it is late, I will wait for you.
No matter late how it is, I will wait for you.
answer: No matter how late it is, I will wait for you.

wrong.No matter how it is late, I will wait fo: how 後面要緊接形容詞 late，再接主詞與動詞。
wrong.No matter late how it is, I will wait fo: how 要放在形容詞前面，how late 才是正確順序。

why: No matter how + 形容詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，是讓步結構。
tip: No matter how + 形容詞，再接主詞與動詞。
say: No matter how late it is, I will wait for you.

text: Child _____ he was, he understood the danger.
options: as
than
so

wrong.than: than 用於比較，不能構成「雖然是孩子」的讓步。
wrong.so: so 不能放在名詞 child 後面表示讓步，語意與結構都不成立。

why: 名詞 + as + 主詞 + be，也是讓步倒裝，Child as he was = Although he was a child。
tip: 名詞也可以前置：Child as he was，雖然還是孩子。
say: Child as he was, he understood the danger.
